title: Balochistan Local Government Election Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2002]
No.Legis:1-122/Law/2002, dated
27-9-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
23rd September, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local
Government Election (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 18-A of Ordinance VI of 2000

BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTION
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XVI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 27th September, 2002]
No.Legis:1-122/Law/2002, dated
27-9-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
23rd September, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 18-A
of Ordinance VI of 2000.---In the Balochistan Local Government Election
Ordinance, 2000 after subsection (3) of section 18-A, the following new
subsection shall be added:--
"(3-A) The period of one
year referred to in subsection. (3) shall be computed from the date of
assumption of office of the council:
Provided that in a year in which
general elections are to be held, the by-elections may be held within eighteen
months."
